s: Namco Bandai Partners Germany is the German subsidiary of Namco Bandai Games Europe. Additionally the company covers the operational business for Austria and Switzerland. Previously it was known as Infogrames Entertainment GmbH and it was based in Dreieich, Germany, as a subsidiary of Infogrames.
